'''Anderson da Silva'''<ref name="fn" /> ({{IPA|pt|ˈɐ̃deʁsõ ˈsiwvɐ}}; born 14 April 1975) is a Brazilian [[mixed martial arts|mixed martial artist]] and [[professional boxer]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://boxrec.com/en/box-pro/152826 | title=BoxRec: Anderson Silva }}</ref> He is a former [[UFC Middleweight Championship|UFC Middleweight Champion]] who unified the UFC Middleweight and [[Pride Fighting Championships|Pride World Welterweight Championship]], and holds the record for the [[List of UFC champions#Longest individual reigns|longest title reign]] in UFC history at 2,457 days. This started in 2006 and ended in 2013 and included a previously held UFC record of 16 consecutive victories in that span.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/extra/mma/news/story?id=5073124 |title=ESPN.go.com April 10, 2010 |publisher=ESPN  |date=10 April 2010 |access-date=11 October 2010}}</ref><ref nam
